name: Gyproc Gypsum Board
description: A high-performance plasterboard used for false ceilings, dry walls, and partitions. Manufactured by Saint-Gobain under the Gyproc brand, it delivers superior fire and sound resistance.

name: Gyproc Gypsum Plaster
description: An eco-friendly, ready-to-use gypsum-based plaster that replaces traditional sand-cement application. Ideal for internal plastering surfaces with no water curing required.

name: Fiber Cement Board (Normal & Plus)
description: Multi-use fiber cement sheets suitable for interior and exterior applications including partitions, cladding, flooring, and false ceilings.

name: Premium Plank & Designer Boards
description: Aesthetically superior fiber cement planks and designer boards for external cladding, garden fencing, and gate cladding.

name: PVC Ceiling & Tiles
description: A range of PVC ceiling systems including laminated gypsum, G.I. metal ceiling, T-grid, and acrylic sheets.

name: Plastic & PVC Gypsum Ceiling Tiles
description: Decorative ceiling tiles in plastic and PVC gypsum variants. Multiple design patterns, easy DIY installation, and excellent cost-to-value ratio.

name: PVC Wooden Panel
description: Wood-finish PVC wall and ceiling panels in groove designs, wallpaper patterns, hot stamping, and WPC variants.

name: Gypframe Expert (Metal Framing System)
description: A complete metal framing solution for gypsum board partitions and false ceilings. Includes ceiling sections, perimeter channels, ceiling angles, and intermediate channels.

name: Ready-Made Wall Panels
description: Pre-finished wall panels for quick interior wall finishing without plastering. Available in various textures and finishes for both residential and commercial use.

name: T-Grid False Ceiling System
description: A suspended ceiling grid system (T-bar / T-grid) used to hold ceiling tiles, fiber cement boards, or gypsum boards.
